coverage.why: Fetched the JSON variant of each venue page (append .json to /venues/<slug>) and paged with ?page=N until each venue's own last page (paging.total_pages), filtering to date <= 2027-05-31. This JSON mirrors what the venue's HTML page renders -- verified against the rendered page for moody-center. Two of the 18 named venues have no current do512 page: 'parish' -- do512's own /venues/parish now 301-redirects to /venues/brushy-street-commons (do512 treats these as the same underlying venue entity, id 152, renamed on their site after The Parish's 2022 move to 501 Brushy St -- confirmed independently via web search: Austin Chronicle/CultureMap reporting on the venue's moves). 'summit' -- no discoverable do512 slug resolves to the open Summit nightclub at 120 W 5th St; the only 'Summit'-named do512 page found (summit-rooftop) is explicitly titled 'CLOSED: Summit Rooftop' with 0 events, which itself may be stale (summitaustin.com shows the venue currently operating). 'empire' (Empire Control Room & Garage) has a valid, correctly-titled do512 page but 0 upcoming events listed -- a real undercoverage finding, not a fetch failure. 'germania' also has a near-duplicate do512 entity at /venues/circuit-of-the-americas (same street address, the broader COTA complex page) which was NOT pulled into this file to avoid conflating amphitheater concerts with the venue's other event types (F1, motorsport, etc.) -- worth a follow-up look if COTA hosts amphitheater shows under its own page that don't also appear on germania-insurance-amphitheater.

cityWide.note: do512 exposes only Today/Tomorrow shortcuts on the citywide live-music listing (no 30-day view). A true 30-day count would need 30 separate daily fetches -- not spent on this per-venue study. The Today page (do512.com/events/live-music.json) showed count=48 across all Austin venues, not just our 17.

linkBehavior: Buy links point straight to the ticketer's own site, not through a do512 redirect or affiliate wrapper. Example (Ticketmaster): https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/3A006471B677B085?CAMEFROM=CFC_MOODY_CENTER_WEB_MOODYSITE_JUNGLE -- the CAMEFROM param is the venue's own marketing tag, not a do512 affiliate tag. AXS/Etix links are similarly direct (e.g. axs.com/events/..., etix.com/ticket/...). Smaller/independent venues (ACL Live, 3TEN, Brushy Street Commons) often point at eventim.us or the venue's own ticketing subdomain directly. 19 of 419 events had buy_url = null in the source (free/RSVP shows, or tickets not yet on sale).
